summary: Amari Galan, 3-year-old special-needs child, left his home near the 900 block of Washington St in Rocky Ford around 4 a.m. wearing only a diaper; Endangered Missing Alert issued; joint multi-agency search focused on the Catlin canal behind the home; SAR personnel searching the banks on foot located his body several miles downstream around 5 p.m. on May 19
responding_agency: Colorado Bureau of Investigation; Rocky Ford Police Department; Otero County Sheriff's Office; Otero County Coroner; Search and Rescue personnel
notes: Borderline frontcountry setting (urban irrigation canal behind residence); in scope as documented multi-agency SAR search with fatality; date = missing date (May 18), body found May 19
